description: Produces a reviewable cross-surface migration plan for an existing skill or plugin. Use when a user asks to port Claude-only behavior to Codex, preserve a legacy name, split shared from surface-specific behavior, or plan compatibility without live cutover.
intent: Translate one existing skill or plugin into a neutral source and surface-specific adapter proposal.
outcome: Produce a provenance-preserving migration, successor, compatibility, and rollback map without changing the live installation.

permissions.allowed_scope: Declared migration sandbox and evidence root only

positive: migrate a Claude skill to Codex
split a plugin into neutral and surface adapters
plan a compatibility alias for an old skill name
negative: archive and remove the live skill

lifecycle.promotion_gate: Cross-surface fixture migrations, compatibility collision tests, rollback evidence, and owner approval

instructions: Fingerprint and statically inspect the complete source tree; do not execute bundled scripts during intake.
Classify each practice or file as shared, claude-only, codex-only, rejected, or superseded and retain source evidence.
Extract one neutral intent and outcome per destination leaf; split independently failing responsibilities before generating adapters.
Map Claude invocation fields and dynamic behavior only to a reviewed Claude adapter; map Codex UI and invocation policy to agents/openai.yaml.
Create exact successor, compatibility, discovery, cutover, and rollback steps; keep aliases lower priority, time-bounded, and collision-tested.
Return proposal files and unresolved conflicts without moving live files, creating junctions, installing, or changing lifecycle state.
